fields.speaker: character id from the event (or 'narration' for scene text)
fields.variants*: optional keyed alternatives; pick by the named key, else use text

_meta.tone: Cozy sitcom. Off results are kind and funny; the customer always pays.

line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_order.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_order.text: One classic lemonade, please. With a quiet straw. Mom says the squeaky ones are rude.

line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_success.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_success.text: Whoa. This is the best lemonade on the whole street. Maybe the whole world. Here's a quarter extra!

line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_okay.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_okay.text: It's good! It's lemon-y and sugar-y. I'm gonna tell everybody.

line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_off.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_drink_classic_first_sale_off.text: It's a little funny... but it's still lemonade! Lemonade is always lemonade. Thank you!

line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_order.speaker: priya_okafor
line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_order.text: Priya here! Could I get the pink one? Like his nose. Biscuit insisted. Well, he blinked at the menu.

line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_success.speaker: priya_okafor
line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_success.text: Oh, that's exactly Biscuit-nose pink! I'm putting it on the Whisker & Bean specials board. With credit.

line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_okay.speaker: priya_okafor
line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_okay.text: A little pale, but sweet. More of a sleepy-nose pink. Biscuit approves, I think. He yawned.

line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_off.speaker: priya_okafor
line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_off.text: That's more of a sunburned-nose pink! Still lovely. Want to try one more pour? No rush at all.

line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_biscuit_.speaker: biscuit
line_ev_drink_pink_biscuit_nose_biscuit_.text: Mrrp? (Biscuit watches the pitcher very, very closely.)

line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_order.speaker: cyclist_from_l3
line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_order.text: Rain's done and I'm soaked. Iced tea lemonade, please. Cold drink, wet jacket. Perfect balance.

line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_success.speaker: cyclist_from_l3
line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_success.text: Oh, that's the sun coming back in a cup. Worth every puddle on the way here.

line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_okay.speaker: cyclist_from_l3
line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_okay.text: Tea's a touch warm, so the ice is racing. I'm racing too. We'll all get there!

line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_off.speaker: cyclist_from_l3
line_ev_drink_icedtea_after_rain_off.text: That's hot tea in a cold disguise! Honestly, cozy after the rain. Want another go? I'm in no hurry.

line_cust_dottie_rain_wave.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_rain_wave.text: Yoo-hoo! Rain's stopped, sweetie. I'll have one of those tea lemonades too. Light ice, my teeth are retired.

line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_order.speaker: grandpa_train_shop
line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_order.text: Walt Hale, all aboard! One strawberry lemonade, caboose-red if you please. This little fella keeps time.

line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_success.speaker: grandpa_train_shop
line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_success.text: Caboose-red, right on schedule! Best stop on the whole line.

line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_okay.speaker: grandpa_train_shop
line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_okay.text: A touch more pink than red. A caboose that's been out in the sun. I'll take it, gladly.

line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_off.speaker: grandpa_train_shop
line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_off.text: Hm! A few berries missed the train. Happens on every line. Shall we run it one more time?

line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_caboose.speaker: grandpa_train_shop
line_ev_drink_strawberry_caboose_caboose.text: You keep the caboose. Every good stand needs a conductor. Toot toot.

line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_order.speaker: pond_jogger
line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_order.text: Mint lemonade, please! Oh, don't mind my friend. He followed me from the pond. He has opinions.

line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_success.speaker: pond_jogger
line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_success.text: That's a breeze off the pond in a cup. And so calm! He didn't even flinch. You're a duck friend now.

line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_okay.speaker: pond_jogger
line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_okay.text: Mint's a little shy, but it's cool and sweet. My little shadow is very content.

line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_off.speaker: pond_jogger
line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_off.text: Whoa, minty! My whole face feels brand new. Want to try a gentler one? We'll wait. He's sitting.

line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_duck_quack.speaker: duckling
line_ev_drink_mint_duckling_duck_quack.text: Quack. (The duckling settles down beside the stand.)

line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_order.speaker: delbert_finch
line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_order.text: Black coffee, please. A quiet cup. This clock and I have an appointment with nothing at all.

line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_succes.speaker: delbert_finch
line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_succes.text: Precisely right. Not a second too strong. I'll be back tomorrow at this same tick.

line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_okay.speaker: delbert_finch
line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_okay.text: A touch thin. Like a clock that runs two minutes slow. Still keeps good company.

line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_off.speaker: delbert_finch
line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_off.text: Ah. This one's running backwards a bit. No matter. Shall we wind it again?

line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_clock_.speaker: narration
line_ev_drink_black_delbert_clock_clock_.text: Tick... tick... (Delbert's pocket clock keeps time on the counter.)

line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_order.speaker: retiring_dentist
line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_order.text: One espresso, please. Before I never hear a drill again. Gerald's along, he's very well behaved.

line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_success.speaker: retiring_dentist
line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_success.text: Perfect crema. And I didn't even check anyone's molars. Retirement is wonderful.

line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_okay.speaker: retiring_dentist
line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_okay.text: A smidge bitter. Like a good flossing. Good for you, mostly.

line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_off.speaker: retiring_dentist
line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_off.text: Very... relaxed shot. On vacation, like me! Want to pull one more? Gerald and I have all day.

line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_gerald_bu.speaker: gerald
line_ev_drink_espresso_dentist_gerald_bu.text: blub. (Gerald makes one tiny, approving bubble.)

line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_order.speaker: npc_vendor
line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_order.text: Brought you honey from my stall and a little lavender bunch. Try the fancy one? I've been dying to taste it.

line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_success.speaker: npc_vendor
line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_success.text: Oh, that's a Saturday morning in a glass! I'm sending my whole aisle over.

line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_okay.speaker: npc_vendor
line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_okay.text: Lavender's a little loud, but it's sweet as can be. Next time, a shorter steep!

line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_off.speaker: npc_vendor
line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_off.text: That's a very sweet candle you've made! Ha! Take another go, there's plenty of honey.

line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_honey_gift.speaker: npc_vendor
line_ev_drink_honeylav_vendor_honey_gift.text: Keep the jar. Honey keeps forever, and so do good neighbors.

line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_order.speaker: npc_architect
line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_order.text: Latte. With this on top. No, wait, this. Okay, this. Final answer. Probably.

line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_success.speaker: npc_architect
line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_success.text: That's... my sketch. In foam. I'm pinning the napkin on your wall. Don't argue, I'm an architect.

line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_okay.speaker: npc_architect
line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_okay.text: Close. It's like my sketch after a second draft. I'll allow it.

line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_off.speaker: npc_architect
line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_off.text: Interesting. Abstract. I may have drawn it upside down anyway. Try again? I'll hold the napkin still.

line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_grudging_.speaker: npc_architect
line_ev_drink_latte_sketch_art_grudging_.text: ...Not bad. Don't let it go to your head.

line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_order.speaker: agnes_pell
line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_order.text: (whispering) One cappuccino, please. Quiet foam, if you have it.

line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_success.speaker: agnes_pell
line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_success.text: (whispering) Lovely. Foam like a turned page. Five stars, silently.

line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_okay.speaker: agnes_pell
line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_okay.text: (whispering) A little thin, but very kind. Like a paperback.

line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_off.speaker: agnes_pell
line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_off.text: (whispering) It's a bit loud, flavor-wise. That's all right, dear. Another one, softly?

line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_shh.speaker: narration
line_ev_drink_cappuccino_quiet_shh.text: shh... (Agnes smiles and taps her book.)

line_cust_wren_whisper_order.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_whisper_order.text: (whispering) A cappuccino, please. I like a quiet foam too.

line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_order.speaker: juno_park
line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_order.text: mocha!! extra whip!! sorry, I'm late, I'm always late, the band's waiting, it's fine!!

line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_success.speaker: juno_park
line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_success.text: OH that's an encore in a cup. Big tip. Biggest tip. You're on the guest list forever.

line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_okay.speaker: juno_park
line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_okay.text: It's chocolatey, it's coffee-ish, it's GREAT. Okay, it's good! Still tipping!

line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_off.speaker: juno_park
line_ev_drink_mocha_juno_off.text: Ha! Hot chocolate with a coffee rumor! I love it. I'm late anyway, wanna try again?

line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_order.speaker: record_store_owner
line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_order.text: Lou Marchetti. Dropped a record on for you. Iced coffee, please, and feel the groove.

line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_success.speaker: record_store_owner
line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_success.text: Every step on the beat. That's a B-side hit. Here's a coupon, my friend.

line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_okay.speaker: record_store_owner
line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_okay.text: A little off the rhythm, but the melody's there. Nice chill.

line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_off.speaker: record_store_owner
line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_off.text: Ha, you skipped a groove! Happens to the best records. Drop the needle again?

line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_needle_drop.speaker: narration
line_ev_drink_iced_on_beat_needle_drop.text: *crackle* (The needle drops. A warm bassline fills the room.)

line_cust_keyclackr_drum_along.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_drum_along.text: *tap tap tap* Sorry! This bassline is a perfect typing tempo.

line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_order.speaker: rosa_pemberton
line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_order.text: Rosa Pemberton, from the greenhouse! Vanilla latte, please. The pod's from my orchid corner. Don't tell Ray.

line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_success.speaker: rosa_pemberton
line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_success.text: Oh, it smells like my orchids at sunrise! I'm naming a bud after this cup.

line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_okay.speaker: rosa_pemberton
line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_okay.text: Vanilla's a little shy, like a bud that's not quite open. Lovely anyway.

line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_off.speaker: rosa_pemberton
line_ev_drink_vanilla_orchid_off.text: That's a lot of vanilla! Ray would say I told you so. Let's try once more, gently.

line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_board_revea.speaker: dana
line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_board_revea.text: New on the board! (Dana chalks the season's flavor in big curly letters.)

variants.spring: New on the board: Blossom Honey Latte!
variants.summer: New on the board: Toasted Coconut Latte!
variants.autumn: New on the board: Maple Pumpkin Latte!
variants.winter: New on the board: Winter Spice Latte!

line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_order.speaker: coworker_npc
line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_order.text: Ooh, the seasonal one! I have no idea what that word means, but I want it.

line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_success.speaker: coworker_npc
line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_success.text: It tastes exactly like this time of year. I'm telling the whole floor.

line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_okay.speaker: coworker_npc
line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_okay.text: Little heavy on the syrup. Very festive. I'm extremely awake now.

line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_off.speaker: coworker_npc
line_ev_drink_seasonal_board_off.text: The topping went on a little adventure down the side! Cute. Want a redo? I'll wait.

line_cust_wren_seasonal_first.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_seasonal_first.text: A new season on the board. I'll write a new poem for it.

line_ev_gen_regular_returns_greeting.speaker: regular
line_ev_gen_regular_returns_greeting.text: Hey, it's me again! Missed this place.

line_ev_gen_regular_returns_usual.speaker: regular
line_ev_gen_regular_returns_usual.text: The usual, please. You remember, right? No pressure!

line_ev_gen_regular_returns_success.speaker: regular
line_ev_gen_regular_returns_success.text: You remembered! That makes my whole day.

line_ev_gen_regular_returns_okay.speaker: regular
line_ev_gen_regular_returns_okay.text: Close to my usual! Close enough to make me smile.

line_ev_gen_regular_returns_off.speaker: regular
line_ev_gen_regular_returns_off.text: Ha, not quite my usual, but you tried! Shall we have another go together?

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_chat_a.speaker: rosa_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_chat_a.text: Ray! Fancy meeting you in line. Have you tried the sweet one?

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_chat_b.speaker: ray_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_chat_b.text: Rosa. I came here to avoid your sugar opinions.

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_order_cha.speaker: ray_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_order_cha.text: Fine. I'll have what she's having. Don't tell her she's right.

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_success.speaker: ray_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_success.text: ...She was right. This one's wonderful. I'll deny saying that.

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_okay.speaker: ray_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_okay.text: Hm. Not bad. Not as good as mine. But not bad.

line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_off.speaker: ray_pemberton
line_ev_gen_two_customers_chat_off.text: See, Rosa? Too much of a good thing! Ha. One more try, though? It's growing on me.

line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_start.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_start.text: Ding ding! Here comes the rush. Everybody's smiling. Take it one cup at a time.

variants.coffee_counter: Ding ding! The morning crowd's here. Deep breath, one cup at a time.
variants.lemonade_stand: Ding ding! Afternoon thirst o'clock. One cup at a time.

line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_clear_great.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_clear_great.text: Rush Hour Hero! Every cup a winner. Dana's doing a tiny victory dance.

line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_clear_okay.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_rush_hour_rush_clear_okay.text: Rush cleared! Everyone left happy and caffeinated (or lemonaded).

line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_arrive.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_arrive.text: Biscuit has arrived. Biscuit is sitting on the counter. Biscuit is in charge now.

line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_customer_aww.speaker: customer
line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_customer_aww.text: Awww! Is he yours? Can I pet him? I'm leaving a cat-photo review.

line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_leave.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_biscuit_visit_leave.text: Biscuit stretches, blinks slowly at you, and strolls off. Business as usual.

line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_short.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_short.text: Um... I'm one quarter short. I counted twice. It's still one quarter.

line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_on_house.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_on_house.text: This one's on the house, kiddo. Enjoy your lemonade.

line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_next_time.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_next_time.text: No worries. Pay me next time, okay?

line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_payback.speaker: neighbor_kid
line_ev_gen_kid_short_quarter_payback.text: I'm back! Here's two quarters, one for last time and one for being nice!

line_ev_gen_critic_visit_arrive.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_critic_visit_arrive.text: A quiet customer with a notebook sits down. They seem to be noticing... everything.

line_ev_gen_critic_visit_order.speaker: food_critic
line_ev_gen_critic_visit_order.text: Your most ambitious drink, please. Take all the time you need.

line_ev_gen_critic_visit_review_great.speaker: food_critic
line_ev_gen_critic_visit_review_great.text: 'A hidden gem. Warm, careful, delicious.' I'll be writing about this.

line_ev_gen_critic_visit_review_okay.speaker: food_critic
line_ev_gen_critic_visit_review_okay.text: 'A charming spot with real heart.' Four stars, with pleasure.

line_cust_pippa_critic_copy.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critic_copy.text: (Pippa sits next to the critic and copies their notes exactly. Same frown. Same pen tap.)

line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_arrive.speaker: marge_holloway
line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_arrive.text: Mile Marker, checking in! New office, new counter. Had to see it with my own eyes.

line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_order.speaker: marge_holloway
line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_order.text: Give me whatever's newest, boss. I like my coffee like my routes: fresh.

line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_logged_and_loa.speaker: marge_holloway
line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_logged_and_loa.text: Logged and loaded. That one's going in the logbook.

line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_hint_next.speaker: marge_holloway
line_ev_gen_marge_checkin_hint_next.text: Word down the road is something new is coming soon. Keep your straps tight.

variants_by_next_drink.pink_lemonade: Heard the cat cafe crowd likes things pink. Just saying.
variants_by_next_drink.iced_tea_lemonade: Rain's on the radio. Something tea-flavored usually follows a good rain.
variants_by_next_drink.strawberry_lemonade: There's a fella with a train set who swears by strawberries. Keep an ear out.
variants_by_next_drink.mint_lemonade: The pond road's got wild mint growing all along it. Smells like a breeze.
variants_by_next_drink.black_coffee: A real office deserves a real coffee counter. Truck-stop rule number one.
variants_by_next_drink.espresso: Small cups, big kick. Somebody retiring might show you how it's done.
variants_by_next_drink.honey_lavender_lemonade: Market day's coming. Honey and lavender, if my nose is right.
variants_by_next_drink.latte: Saw an architect doodling on napkins. Bet they'd like a drawing on their coffee.
variants_by_next_drink.cappuccino: Libraries run on quiet foam, I hear. Whisper it.
variants_by_next_drink.mocha: A warehouse morning calls for chocolate. Don't argue with Mile Marker.
variants_by_next_drink.iced_coffee: Record shop owner brews it cold and slow. Keeps a good beat.
variants_by_next_drink.vanilla_latte: There's a florist with an orchid corner. Smells like vanilla, I'm told.
variants_by_next_drink.seasonal_special: Fancy offices have fancy menu boards. Chalk's already in my glovebox.

line_ev_gen_weather_turn_rain_start.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_weather_turn_rain_start.text: Pitter-patter! Customers huddle under the awning. Something warm, or tea with lemon?

line_ev_gen_weather_turn_heat_start.speaker: narration
line_ev_gen_weather_turn_heat_start.text: Phew, a hot one! Everyone's fanning themselves and asking for extra ice.

line_ev_gen_weather_turn_weather_quip.speaker: queue_npc
line_ev_gen_weather_turn_weather_quip.text: Weather's changing, but this line's still the coziest spot in town.

variants.rain: Rain makes everything taste better under an awning.
variants.heat: Extra ice, please! I'm basically a puddle.

line_cust_dottie_rain_traffic.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_rain_traffic.text: Single file under the awning, everybody! Umbrellas in, elbows friendly.

line_cust_rocco_heat_ice.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_heat_ice.text: Extra ice, chief! It's ninety degrees on my route and Biscuit the beagle wants shade.

line_ev_gen_review_board_fan_favourite.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_review_board_fan_favourite.text: Fan favourite today: {drink}! The people have spoken.

line_ev_gen_review_board_tip_note.speaker: dana
line_ev_gen_review_board_tip_note.text: Sticky note from Dana: Try a little less ice next time. You're doing great!

variants_by_weakest_part.ingredients: Sticky note: double-check the recipe card. You're doing great!
variants_by_weakest_part.order: Sticky note: steps in order make it sing. You're doing great!
variants_by_weakest_part.amounts: Sticky note: a little less pour, a little more taste. You're doing great!
variants_by_weakest_part.ice_temp: Sticky note: watch the ice and the heat. You're doing great!
variants_by_weakest_part.timing: Sticky note: a quick serve keeps it fresh. No rush, though. You're doing great!

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_order.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_order.text: One black coffee, please. I'd like to acquire it.

variants_by_drink.espresso: One espresso, please. Small, dense, reliable.
variants_by_drink.vanilla_latte: A vanilla latte, please. Weekend acquisition.

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_stackable_.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_stackable_.text: Quick question: are the cups stackable? For science. And joy.

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_stack_done.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_stack_done.text: Look at that. A perfect stack. May I acquire one for the collection?

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_gr.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_gr.text: Five staples out of five. Acquired with joy. Here's exact change, plus two.

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_ok.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_ok.text: Three staples. Solid binding. A dependable cup.

line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_of.speaker: steve
line_cust_steve_staple_rating_staples_of.text: Two staples. But they still hold the pages together! Paying with exact change.

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_order.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_order.text: Pink lemonade, sweetie! It's golden hour and I want something that glows.

variants_by_drink.honey_lavender_lemonade: The honey-lavender, please! It's golden hour, darling.
variants_by_drink.latte: A latte, please! Lots of foam for the low light.

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_hold_to_.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_hold_to_.text: (Lorna lifts the cup toward the setting sun.) Oh, look at that. Just look at it.

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_warm_wat.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_warm_wat.text: Warm wattage! A hundred watts of happy!

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_forty_wa.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_forty_wa.text: A cozy forty watts. Perfect for reading by.

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_dim_but_.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_dim_but_.text: A little dim, but that's okay. I brought my own sunshine! Paying, of course.

line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_lamp_gif.speaker: lamp_lady
line_cust_lamp_lady_golden_hour_lamp_gif.text: This is for you, darling. Every stand needs a little lamp. Doesn't it glow?

line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_typing.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_typing.text: *clack clack clack* Order coming in! Hold on, autocorrect is fighting me.
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_typing.note: Event drink is black_coffee (L6). Espresso unlocks at L7; after that the ticket can show the ticket_espresso variant.

line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_typo_fix.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_typo_fix.text: Ha, thanks. You fixed my typo faster than I did. Zero input lag.

line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_tactile.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_tactile.text: Tactile. Perfect actuation. Posting a five-star review with a keyboard emoji. ⌨️

line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_linear.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_linear.text: Linear. Smooth enough. 7/10, wuold sip again. Would. Would sip.

line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_mushy.speaker: keyclackr
line_cust_keyclackr_typed_order_mushy.text: Bit mushy, like a membrane board. Still paying! Payign. Paying.

line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_stand_up.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_stand_up.text: Alright, everybody! (Dottie stands up and straightens her vest.) Thirty years of training, here we go.

line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_wave_lin.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_wave_lin.text: You first, then you, then you. Nice and easy. Nobody's in a rush here.

line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_you_go_f.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_you_go_f.text: You go ahead, sweetie. I'm retired. I've got all day.

line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_smooth_t.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_smooth_t.text: Smooth traffic today. I'm so proud of all of you.

line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_slow_dow.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_crossing_guard_slow_dow.text: Slow down, sweetie. You're doing fine. Better than fine.

line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_arrive_bag.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_arrive_bag.text: I brought you something, dear. Lemons from Harold's old tree. Still going strong, just like me.

line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_harold_story.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_harold_story.text: Harold planted that tree the week we got married. Every summer he'd make lemonade too sour, and I'd add sugar when he wasn't looking.

line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_harold_proud.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_harold_proud.text: Oh, that's it. That's the one. Harold's lemon tree would be proud.

line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_bag_gift.speaker: dottie
line_cust_dottie_lemon_tree_bag_gift.text: You keep the rest. A jar of lemons looks lovely on a windowsill. He'd like that.

line_cust_theo_night_shift_order.speaker: theo
line_cust_theo_night_shift_order.text: A coffee to sleep after, please. Somehow it works. Don't ask.
line_cust_theo_night_shift_order.note: Event drink is black_coffee (L6). Latte unlocks at L9; from then the latte variant can play.

variants_by_drink.black_coffee: Black coffee, please. Then sleep. In that order.
variants_by_drink.latte: A latte, hot as you can, extra foam. I'm basically a cloud now.

line_cust_theo_night_shift_thanks_twice.speaker: theo
line_cust_theo_night_shift_thanks_twice.text: Thank you. And thank you. Once for each eye that's open.

line_cust_theo_night_shift_vitals_stable.speaker: theo
line_cust_theo_night_shift_vitals_stable.text: Vitals stable. Drink is fine. So am I. Mostly.

line_cust_theo_night_shift_worse_at_4am.speaker: theo
line_cust_theo_night_shift_worse_at_4am.text: I've had worse at 4 a.m. Many times. This is lovely by comparison. Thank you, truly.

line_cust_pippa_critique_arrive_official.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critique_arrive_official.text: Hello. This is an official review. Please act natural.

line_cust_pippa_critique_watching.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critique_watching.text: (Pippa leans in, clipboard up, watching every pour.) Mm-hmm. Interesting. Very interesting.

variants_by_band.great: Balance: gold star. Sweet and sour are best friends.
variants_by_band.okay: Balance: silver star. A tiny bit more lemon, please.
variants_by_band.off: Balance: nice-try frog. Next time, taste before you serve!

variants_by_band.great: Chill: gold star. Perfect ice. My brain is only slightly frozen.
variants_by_band.okay: Chill: silver star. One more scoop of ice next time.
variants_by_band.off: Chill: nice-try frog. The ice went on vacation.

variants_by_band.great: Service: gold star. Fast and friendly.
variants_by_band.okay: Service: silver star. Good, a little slow. That's okay!
variants_by_band.off: Service: nice-try frog. But you smiled the whole time. That counts.

line_cust_pippa_critique_gold_seal.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critique_gold_seal.text: Three gold stars. That's the Official Seal. It's going right here on your stand. Don't peel it off.

line_cust_pippa_critique_silver_tip.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critique_silver_tip.text: Silver star. Room to grow! Tip: work on your weakest box. I believe in you.

line_cust_pippa_critique_frog_tip.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_critique_frog_tip.text: You get the nice-try frog. He's very proud of you. Tip: one thing at a time. I'll check back next time!

line_cust_pippa_margins_margins_ask.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_margins_margins_ask.text: Question. What are your profit margins? Just curious. For my future empire.

line_cust_pippa_margins_ledger_card.speaker: narration
line_cust_pippa_margins_ledger_card.text: One cup: price {price}, ingredients {cost}, you keep {profit}. That's about {margin_pct}% for you!

line_cust_pippa_margins_business_partner.speaker: pippa
line_cust_pippa_margins_business_partner.text: Makes sense. You're a smart business. Future business partner. I'm writing it down.

line_cust_rocco_route_stop_arrive_route.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_arrive_route.text: Two minutes, chief! Step count's on! Strawberry lemonade, please. My mint's still in the mail.
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_arrive_route.note: Base text is L1-L4 only (min_level/max_level, banter.json convention): mint lemonade unlocks at L5. From L5 onward use variants_by_level['L5+'] (variants_by_level_range: min_level L5, no max).

variants_by_level.L5+: Two minutes, chief! Step count's on! Strawberry for the event, but hey, the mint finally got delivered!

line_cust_rocco_route_stop_gossip.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_gossip.text: Got some news from the route, hot off the satchel...
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_gossip.note: Gossip is a hint about the NEXT level. Pick variants_by_next_level[next level]. Rocco appears from L4, so the first hint teases L5.

variants_by_next_level.L5: Heads up: they're closing the bridge for repairs. Detour goes right round the duck pond. Ducks have the right of way, you know.
variants_by_next_level.L6: Word is there's a sunny room up above the bakery. Smells like bread every morning. Just saying, chief.
variants_by_next_level.L7: The dentist on Elm's finally retiring. Big chair, lots of glass, and a fish named Gerald. Gerald's a VIP.
variants_by_next_level.L8: Saturday's market day! Watch the lanes, though. Last week a cabbage made a run for it.
variants_by_next_level.L9: There's an architect on my route who's redrawn her own front door three times this week.
variants_by_next_level.L10: Library's moving to the new branch. Don't tell anyone, but I heard there's a secret letter tucked in one of the books.
variants_by_next_level.L11: Delivered a package to an old brick warehouse. Huge windows, clanky elevator. Real business vibes.
variants_by_next_level.L12: The record shop's owner keeps a turntable spinning all day long. My route goes faster past there.
variants_by_next_level.L13: Did a late route last night. The streets glow after dark, and a little cat followed me three whole blocks.
variants_by_next_level.L14: The greenhouse twins are fighting about pots again. Somebody's going to have to move all those plants.
variants_by_next_level.L15: Drove the coast road. Windy! A gull stole my sandwich. Worth it for the lighthouse.
variants_by_next_level.L16: There's a glass suite downtown with room for a whole team. Fancy! Bet you'd look good in there.
variants_by_next_level.L17: The theater's opening night is coming up and the director's in a panic. Piano, castle wall, rubber chicken, the works.
variants_by_next_level.L18: Parade's this weekend! Main road's closed, so plan a detour. Follow the band if you get lost.
variants_by_next_level.L19: A rival mover's been asking about you. Very snooty. Very shiny shoes. I think they're secretly impressed.
variants_by_next_level.L20: Up at the mountain lodge, they say the cocoa's the best in the state. And the first snow's on its way.
variants_by_next_level.L21: There's a corner office with floor-to-ceiling windows sitting empty. I'd keep my eye on that one, chief.
variants_by_next_level.L22: Some kid starting a business is asking about an old garage. Funny how things come back around, huh?

line_cust_rocco_route_stop_personal_best.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_personal_best.text: Personal best! Look at that step counter go!

line_cust_rocco_route_stop_dented.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_dented.text: Arrived a little dented, but it got here! That's what counts.

line_cust_rocco_route_stop_return_to_sen.speaker: rocco
line_cust_rocco_route_stop_return_to_sen.text: Return to sender? Nah, I'll keep it. Paid in full!

line_cust_wren_haiku_card_sip_count.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_sip_count.text: (Wren sips slowly.) Seven bubbles. No, eight. One was hiding.
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_sip_count.note: Event drink is black_coffee (L6); Wren orders black coffee until honey-lavender unlocks at L8.

variants_by_drink.black_coffee: (Wren holds the cup close and looks in.) Dark as a quiet night. One small bubble, like a moon.
variants_by_drink.honey_lavender_lemonade: (Wren sips slowly.) Seven bubbles. No, eight. One was hiding. And the lavender is humming.

line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_great.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_great.text:
Warm between my palms
a small sun I can hold close
thank you, morning hands
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_great.note: Default great haiku; prefer reviews.json per_customer_product.wren[drink].great when present.
lines: a small sun I can hold close

line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_okay.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_okay.text:
Almost there, just like
the first warm day of April.
Still, I'm glad of it.
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_okay.note: Default okay haiku; prefer reviews.json per_customer_product.wren[drink].okay when present.
lines: the first warm day of April.

line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_off.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_off.text:
Brave little cup, you
tried your best and so did I.
Here, for your effort.
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_haiku_off.note: Default off haiku; prefer reviews.json per_customer_product.wren[drink].off when present.
lines: tried your best and so did I.

line_cust_wren_haiku_card_napkin_tip.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_haiku_card_napkin_tip.text: (Wren folds the napkin into a tiny square and tucks it under the cup.) For you.

line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_notice_napkin.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_notice_napkin.text: You kept them? All my napkins? Oh. I don't know what to say. That's rare for me.

line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_pin_request.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_pin_request.text: Could we pin them up somewhere? A little poem corner. Anywhere you like.

line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_shop_haiku.speaker: wren
line_cust_wren_napkin_wall_shop_haiku.text:
Warm cups, kind faces
a corner where words can rest
this place is a verse
lines: a corner where words can rest

_meta.scheme: line_leave_<reason>_<customer>_<n>; reason is patience (patience ran out) or shiftend (shift ended with a queue); customer is a regular id or 'generic' (speaker 'customer')
_meta.tone: Warm and neutral, never guilt-tripping. The customer leaves for their own cheerful reason and plans to come back. No Rep or star change implied.

line_leave_patience_steve_1.speaker: steve
line_leave_patience_steve_1.text: Oh! Meeting in five. I'll grab one tomorrow. Save me a stackable cup?

line_leave_shiftend_steve_1.speaker: steve
line_leave_shiftend_steve_1.text: Closing time? Fair. Even staplers need rest. See you tomorrow!

line_leave_shiftend_steve_2.speaker: steve
line_leave_shiftend_steve_2.text: No worries. I'll file this under 'tomorrow'. Alphabetically, it's very close.

line_leave_patience_lamp_lady_1.speaker: lamp_lady
line_leave_patience_lamp_lady_1.text: Oh, the light's changing, darling! I'll pop back when it's golden again.

line_leave_patience_lamp_lady_2.speaker: lamp_lady
line_leave_patience_lamp_lady_2.text: I've just remembered a lamp I left on. Back soon, sweetie!

line_leave_shiftend_lamp_lady_1.speaker: lamp_lady
line_leave_shiftend_lamp_lady_1.text: Lights out already? Lovely. Sleep well, and I'll see you at golden hour.

line_leave_patience_keyclackr_1.speaker: keyclackr
line_leave_patience_keyclackr_1.text: Brb! Gotta catch a group buy. Back tomorow. Tomorrow.

line_leave_shiftend_keyclackr_1.speaker: keyclackr
line_leave_shiftend_keyclackr_1.text: Shop's closing? All good, I'll queue up again tomorrow. Saving my order to drafts.

line_leave_shiftend_keyclackr_2.speaker: keyclackr
line_leave_shiftend_keyclackr_2.text: GG for today! Same time tomorrow, friend. ⌨️

line_leave_patience_dottie_1.speaker: dottie
line_leave_patience_dottie_1.text: I'll let the young ones go first, sweetie. I'll be back tomorrow. I've got all day, every day.

line_leave_patience_dottie_2.speaker: dottie
line_leave_patience_dottie_2.text: Oh, there's my bus! You're doing wonderfully, dear. See you soon.

line_leave_shiftend_dottie_1.speaker: dottie
line_leave_shiftend_dottie_1.text: Closing up? Good for you, dear. Everyone needs to go home on time. Harold always said so.

line_leave_patience_theo_1.speaker: theo
line_leave_patience_theo_1.text: My eyes are voting for bed. I'll come back tomorrow. Thank you anyway.

line_leave_shiftend_theo_1.speaker: theo
line_leave_shiftend_theo_1.text: Closing? Same. Go rest. Doctor's orders. Well, nurse's.

line_leave_shiftend_theo_2.speaker: theo
line_leave_shiftend_theo_2.text: Shift's over for both of us, then. See you after my next one.

line_leave_patience_pippa_1.speaker: pippa
line_leave_patience_pippa_1.text: I have to go, it's almost snack time. The official review is postponed. Not cancelled!

line_leave_patience_pippa_2.speaker: pippa
line_leave_patience_pippa_2.text: My mom's waving. I'll be back tomorrow with my clipboard. Be ready!

line_leave_shiftend_pippa_1.speaker: pippa
line_leave_shiftend_pippa_1.text: Closing time is a smart business choice. I'm writing that down. See you tomorrow!

line_leave_patience_rocco_1.speaker: rocco
line_leave_patience_rocco_1.text: Gotta keep the route moving, chief! I'll swing by tomorrow. Step count waits for no one!

line_leave_shiftend_rocco_1.speaker: rocco
line_leave_shiftend_rocco_1.text: All closed up? No problem! I'll deliver myself back tomorrow, first thing.

line_leave_shiftend_rocco_2.speaker: rocco
line_leave_shiftend_rocco_2.text: Out for delivery till tomorrow, chief. Keep the counter warm!

line_leave_patience_wren_1.speaker: wren
line_leave_patience_wren_1.text: (Wren smiles and tucks their pencil away.) Another day. The poem can wait.

line_leave_shiftend_wren_1.speaker: wren
line_leave_shiftend_wren_1.text:
The day folds itself
like a napkin, soft and small.
Until tomorrow.
lines: like a napkin, soft and small.

line_leave_shiftend_wren_2.speaker: wren
line_leave_shiftend_wren_2.text: Closing is a kind of rest too. Goodnight.

line_leave_patience_generic_1.speaker: customer
line_leave_patience_generic_1.text: I'll come back tomorrow! Looks like a good one.

line_leave_patience_generic_2.speaker: customer
line_leave_patience_generic_2.text: Oh, I've got to run. Next time for sure!

line_leave_patience_generic_3.speaker: customer
line_leave_patience_generic_3.text: No rush at all, I'll swing by later. Have a lovely day!

line_leave_shiftend_generic_1.speaker: customer
line_leave_shiftend_generic_1.text: Closing up? Totally fine. See you tomorrow!

line_leave_shiftend_generic_2.speaker: customer
line_leave_shiftend_generic_2.text: Early night for everyone! I'll be first in line next time.

line_leave_shiftend_generic_3.speaker: customer
line_leave_shiftend_generic_3.text: Thanks for a great day, everyone. Same time tomorrow!

_meta.scheme: pippa_tip_<box>_<n>; box is balance | chill | service (the clipboard rows); n is 1 or 2 (alternates)
_meta.use: On an okay (silver star) result, show the tip for Pippa's lowest-scoring box (by its share: Balance /70, Chill /15, Service /15) in the 'Pippa's tip' panel, alternating _1 and _2. Fallback: line_cust_pippa_critique_silver_tip. Gold and frog results keep gold_seal / frog_tip.

pippa_tip_balance_1.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_balance_1.text: Silver star! Tip: taste first to fix your Balance box. I believe in you.

pippa_tip_balance_2.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_balance_2.text: Silver star! Tip: Balance box. Sweet and sour need to hold hands. Almost!

pippa_tip_chill_1.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_chill_1.text: Silver star! Tip: Chill box. Ice goes in first, then the pour. You can do it!

pippa_tip_chill_2.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_chill_2.text: Silver star. Tip: your Chill box is almost frosty. Just a few more cubes!

pippa_tip_service_1.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_service_1.text: Silver star! Tip: your Service box. Hand it over a teeny bit faster. Go, go!

pippa_tip_service_2.speaker: pippa
pippa_tip_service_2.text: Silver star. Tip: Service box! Smiling is great. Smiling faster is greater.
